exposure: Prescription drugs (number of unique medication names)
Medicine doses (total number of doses of all medicines administered)
Specific drug types (e.g., Vitamin K1, hepatitis B vaccine, cefoperazone-sulbactam, antimicrobials, domperidone, simethicone)
cohort: The study included 319 neonates who were inpatients in the neonatal intensive care unit and general neonatal ward of West China Second University Hospital between March 1 and April 1, 2018.
finding: The most commonly prescribed antimicrobials in the Chinese neonatal unit differed significantly from those reported in other countries, and there was evidence of irrational prescribing due to a poor evidence base for some medicines.
